name: Monique Lhuillier
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $1495 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's evening gowns, cocktail dresses and bridal, mostly $3,500–$10,000 a gown, plus ready-to-wear, shoes and bags, sold through its own salons, site and department stores.
origin: Founded in 1996 by Monique Lhuillier; Tom Bugbee.

ownership.owner: Monique Lhuillier, Inc. (founder-owned; no outside investment per the founder, 2021)

quote.q: I didn’t want to just be in a woman’s life for her wedding.
quote.src: South Coast Plaza, The Edit (Q&A by Ingrid Schmidt)

opview: “I didn’t want to just be in a woman’s life for her wedding.” — Monique Lhuillier, founder and designer, South Coast Plaza, The Edit (Q&A by Ingrid Schmidt)

facts_read.source: brand site; brand terms; South Coast Plaza Q&A 2021-11; neimanmarcus.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

doors.note: 3 US flagships (LA, Costa Mesa, NYC) + London (not US). Separate /pages/retail-locations page for wholesale stockists not rowed.

notes.fabric: no fabric dials (ruled 15 Oct): held: only 13 of 80 sampled styles publish a composition
notes.tech: Thread proposed 1 (2026-10-14): no named technical fabric on the site. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
notes.craft: Thread proposed 2 (2026-10-14): Country of make is on almost every product page, mostly USA with an Italian share, and the founding is dated (1996). Nothing names where in the USA, who sews, or which mills weave the mikado and faille, so this is a country-of-make 2. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.

craft_evidence.heritage: dated, place implied — 'Established in 1996 by Monique Lhuillier and her husband Tom Bugbee'; Los Angeles named as home and flagship
craft_evidence.reasoning: Country of make is on almost every product page, mostly USA with an Italian share, and the founding is dated (1996). Nothing names where in the USA, who sews, or which mills weave the mikado and faille, so this is a country-of-make 2.
